title: Veronese subring and its regraded direct-sum decomposition
statement: Let $k$ and $R$ be commutative rings, let $R$ be a $k$-algebra, and let $R=\bigoplus_{n\geq0}R_n$ be a grading by $k$-submodules. For a positive integer $d$, the Veronese ring $R^{(d)}$ is the subring of $R$ generated by $\bigcup_{n\geq0}R_{nd}$. Its degree-$n$ subgroup is the inverse image of $R_{nd}$ under the inclusion $R^{(d)}\hookrightarrow R$. These subgroups give a direct-sum decomposition of $R^{(d)}$, with inherited unit and multiplication, so this is the regraded ring $\bigoplus_{n\geq0}R_{nd}$, with $(R^{(d)})_n=R_{nd}$.
